verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state the platform lets you 'Call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API' via the same serverless endpoint (together-ai-docs-21), and the 100+ open-source models overview supports broad model access (together-ai-docs-2, together-ai-docs-32/33). However, there is no explicit documentation of vision (image-understanding) model support, no dedicated audio/image-generation API reference pages, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of these modalities working well. Missing for 10: explicit vision-model docs, dedicated image-gen/audio API reference pages, and independent verification of multimodal quality.
